hero.title: File:Nometramway2.jpg
hero.description: Tramway bringing passengers ashore at Nome late gold rush (1907 or later.) The tower in the picture has a crane suggesting the loading of lighters might take place there. However, the tower crane is small and is absent in later pictures showing the tramway in operation. File:Landing freight at Nome.jpg.[citation needed]
categories: Aerial lifts in the United States
